name: Apple M5 Ultra (Mac Studio, 2026)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple tech specs: '1.2TB/s memory bandwidth' for the M5 Ultra with 30-core CPU / 64-core GPU or 36-core CPU / 80-core GPU. Unified-memory bandwidth, package-level, shared with the CPU.
notes: M5 Ultra: 64-core or 80-core GPU, 32-core Neural Engine, up to 512GB unified memory. The 1.2TB/s bandwidth is the highest of any Apple Silicon chip and exceeds many discrete GPUs. For local LLM inference, 512GB unified memory can hold multiple 70B models simultaneously or a single very large model with massive context. The 1.2TB/s bandwidth yields roughly 30-50 tokens/sec for a 70B model at 4-bit. The M5 Ultra is the highest-performance Apple Silicon chip for local inference, found only in Mac Studio. Two M5 Max dies via UltraFusion. tdp_w 480W is the Mac Studio system maximum continuous power, not a GPU TDP.
